work.title: Lift 7 inline physics violations to constants.ts
work.description: Move spark-gap formula (EDMCuttingParamFlush:739), decay 0.70 (EDMMultiPass:167), Klocke exponents (EDMMultiPass:318,443), kerf overcut coefficients (WEDMKerf:79-82), thin-wire derate (WEDMThinWire:93-94), wire lag coefficient (WEDMCorner:71). Replace with imports. Physics agent must pass.

work.title: Add flush-pressure wire deflection formula
work.description: constants.ts + WEDMWireDeflectionEngine extension: δ_flush = (p·d·L²)/(8T). Source: Dauw & Albert (1992) CIRP Annals 41(1). 10+ tests against published benchmarks.

work.title: Add wire Joule heating + skim Ra cascade formulas
work.description: (1) P_wire = I²·ρ·L/A, ΔT = P·t/(m·cp) — Kunieda (2005) CIRP 54(2). (2) Ra_n = Ra_0·ρ^(n-1) — Klocke (2013) §8.3. 15+ tests.

work.title: Add corner lag + thin-wire power density formulas
work.description: (1) lag = F_d·t_response/(2T) — Dekeyser & Snoeys (1989) CIRP 38. (2) P/A = I·V/(π·d·L_arc) — Rajurkar & Wang (1993) ASME JMSE 115. 12+ tests.

work.title: Add servo voltage + debris short-circuit + coated-wire current limit tables
work.description: (1) Vg = Vo·(1-I·R_arc/Vo) — Mohri (2002). (2) SC_ratio = f(C_debris, V_flush, gap) — Cetin (2003). (3) Per-coating J_max from Bedra Handbook 2019. 15+ tests.
